title: "Researching Letters vs. Numbers, in the Context of..."
---

What is the difference between letters and numbers, in the context of Abstract Fields? Mathematics, Computation, even Chemistry and Music, may use letters and numbers as abstract affordances of Language.

Mathematics however, assigns meaning to special characters: Greek Epsilon, for instance, has a specific purpose and function in Mathematics. While "xyz" are used as arbitrary placeholders in Algebra, "abc" is often used for known values. This was developed historically, and most often Attributed to Renee DesCartes. Therefore, it appears that convention, specification or standardization, is both a group effort, and an individual intellectual excavation.
